description: Provides PartVault SQLite inventory logging, stock queries, bin location management, and KiCad unified part view integration.
author: Charon Librarian

check_inventory.description: Queries PartVault SQLite database for component stock levels, bin locations, datasheets, and metadata.

mpn.description: Manufacturer Part Number or partial query string to search.

query.description: Alternative query parameter for component search.

log_inventory.description: Logs incoming component stock, bin assignments, categories, and footprints into PartVault SQLite.

mpn.description: Manufacturer Part Number to log into inventory.

quantity.description: Number of component units to add (default: 1).

storage_bin.description: Physical bin or storage location ID.
